# DreamLedger

DreamLedger is a NZD commerce and evidence surface. Public commercial truth is Stripe live settlement plus fulfillment evidence. Internal rows, clicks, test mode and checkout intent are not revenue.

## Human surfaces
- https://dreamledger.org/
- https://dreamledger.org/mtg
- https://dreamledger.org/billboard

- https://dreamledger.org/agent-commerce

- https://dreamledger.org/guides/ai-product-discovery-nz.html
- https://dreamledger.org/guides/proving-online-transactions.html
- https://dreamledger.org/guides/nz-physical-goods-price-check.html

## Machine surfaces

## Commerce truth
Supported current payment rail: Stripe Payment Links / Stripe Checkout.
Settlement authority: Stripe live mode.
Verified revenue requires external payment evidence, attribution and fulfillment evidence.
DreamLedger does not treat test payments, self-payments, clicks, rows or claims as revenue.

## Agent behaviour
Discover offers from machine manifests. Present the listed NZD amount and checkout URL. Human authorization remains required before spend. Do not invent payment references or verified revenue.

## Evidence
Public proof schema: dreamledger/proof/v1
Economic loop order: discover -> authorize -> pay -> deliver -> prove.
